source: Written for the corpus: a passage announced once, then verses called by number.

segments.text: Our text this morning is from Joshua chapter 14.
Verse 12 says, give me this mountain.
Now go back with me to verse 6.
Caleb was forty years old, he says.
Thank you, you may be seated.
Matthew chapter 5 verse 14, you are the light of the world.
And verse 16, let your light so shine before men.
